CONVERT(#{code} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = CONVERT(#{roleCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin

SELECT u.id AS id, u.login_name AS loginName, u.display_name AS displayName, un.unit_name AS unitName, u.status AS status FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = CONVERT(#{roleCode} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin ORDER BY u.login_name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=BIGINT}
